text:
“I know I’m supposed to be happy right now…but I’m not.”

something u hear from ppl more often than you'd like

5 ways to get there

1.  the main one I think, is when someone older is reflecting on the past...which is now your present.

the best analogy is from schopenhauer in the quoted tweet...happiness lies in the future and past but never the present:

“Happiness lies always in the future, or else in the past, and the present is like a small dark cloud driven by the wind over the sunny plain. In front of and behind the cloud everything is bright; only it itself always casts a shadow.”

future/past are illusions. the only real one is present.

so the past, to them, has taken on a brighter tint.

and they're telling u how happy u should be right now

meanwhile ur in the small dark cloud - as we all are, and as they were at your age.

this is a temporal mismatch that will never resolve. be aware of it, otherwise u will wonder whats wrong with u...when its really the older person being an ignorant dick, tbh

2. having wrong expectations about the future

can use schopenhauer again

u thought the future would be bright. its not, its the same color cloud as always

u have a broken worldview re: how past and future are processed in ur mind....they are deceptive.

past and future don't exist, esp in that bright tint. ignore them or be aware of how they deceive. 

it's all present, it's all you've ever had, and it's all the same color grey. live there...u aren't "supposed" to be any happier than u are right now.

3. "living the life others want u to live and not ur own life."

straightforward. will always make u miserable. 

there is only one life which wont...or at least, offers a glimmer of hope:  ur own.

4. blind adherence to societal programming

same.  ur living a life that isnt ur own.

dont expect any one-size-fits-all life to satisfy u, think critically over why someone is telling u something.

ask "why do u think the way u do?"

they're botted, programmed, they don't know.  

dont let ppl like that tell you how to live your life lol

5. getting suckered into something.  

usually a house or a car or some shit....a vacation, an experience...u got sold.

none of that makes u happy. 

best shot u have, is living ur own life. if ur gut, ur soul are speaking, listen to them

LAST...

most importantly, the flip side is that the following also exists:

“I know I’m supposed to be sad right now…but I’m not.”

I have experienced this several times. Its real

"I'm supposed to be shattered rn, why do I feel a deep sense of peace?"

I don’t have an explanation for this, sometimes you’ll have ur life in pieces around you, and then the slightest thing will brighten your mood...or, even nothing at all.

"the peace which passeth all understanding."

if something seems one-sided, look again.

all blades really do have 2 edges...the traces of divine design...and the duality of man reigns in all matters, great or small.

quotedTweet.text:
two more excerpts

first, this imagery stays with you:

“Happiness lies always in the future, or else in the past, and the present is like a small dark cloud driven by the wind over the sunny plain. In front of and behind the cloud everything is bright; only it itself always casts a shadow.”

you notice it mostly in other people. they remember being happy in the past and they aim to be happy in the future. but they are never happy in the present. 

once u understand these operations of the mind, for lack of a better phrase, u can stop pissing away time on eras that are not in ur control. 

pascal's words are the best here:

"We do not rest satisfied with the present. We anticipate the future as too slow in coming, as if in order to hasten its course; or we recall the past, to stop its too rapid flight. So imprudent are we that we wander in the times which are not ours, and do not think of the only one which belongs to us; and so idle are we that we dream of those times which are no more, and thoughtlessly overlook that which alone exists. For the present is generally painful to us. We conceal it from our sight, because it troubles us; and if it be delightful to us, we regret to see it pass away. We try to sustain it by the future, and think of arranging matters which are not in our power, for a time which we have no certainty of reaching."

thats basically it - u are wandering in times which are not yours.

and then last, this is another section from Volume 2 where u may agree, u may disagree, but its going to force u to think.

some would say thats the greatest gift a man could ask for...
